formula: relH = lodGroupSize * lodBias / (2 * distance * tan(fovDeg/2 * pi/180))
notes: screenHeights are authoring values for LOD.screenRelativeTransitionHeight [0-1]
recommendedLodBias is the intended QualitySettings.lodBias when using this profile
Do not treat LODGroup.size as an assumed deck height; always measure after RecalculateBounds
On this asset Unity RecalculateBounds yields lodGroupSizeMeasured ≈ 213.4 m (longest bounds axis = length). Use the measured value in relH.
Quality settings may still multiply thresholds via lodBias; record both in reports
Research basis: research/queen-mary-refine-lod/REPORT.md (2026-09-18); numbers are project calibration, not engine standards

profiles.description: Tactical mid-range observation 50-200 m; keep silhouette massing (hull, 3 funnels, 4 turret blocks, superstructure, pole mast, sternwalk).
Fleet-scale camera ~1-2 km; automatic LOD must be able to span levels when size/bias/fov are known.
